title: Millennials & Gen Z: Young And In Debt. Why? | Talking Point | Full Episode
summary: Singapore current-affairs documentary on young adults' cost-of-living struggles, including a segment on Atome buy-now-pay-later use and risks.

assertions.quote: buy now, pay later does nothing to the principal

verdicts.note: This is the standard regulatory and industry description of how pay-in-four products are structured, distinct from revolving credit.
KC Fed describes BNPL as short-term loans with a fixed number of installments over a fixed period, each purchase underwritten and approved separately, unlike a revolving credit card line.

assertions.quote: those penalties act as sort of a pseudo-interest in some sense
seven in 10 say they spend more each month now
six in 10 are unable to pay their monthly instalments in full

verdicts.note: Multiple consumer surveys have found a majority of buy now pay later users unable to pay their installments in full.

assertions.quote: this is textbook licensing... you deserve to spend a lot of money because you've done this virtuous behaviour

verdicts.note: The documented shift toward everyday use coincided with a wave of influencer and marketing content showcasing the apps.

assertions.quote: we have a default rate... that is actually very much below the industry average

verdicts.note: A vendor's self-reported default rate, not independently audited; treated as unverified until confirmed by outside data.
